Aceitar Rejeitar Pular para conteúdo principal LinkedIn Vagas Limpar texto Limpar texto Entrar Cadastre-se agora Legal Counsel - DAL Third Bridge Group Dallas, Texas, Estados Unidos Há 6 dias 26 candidaturas Veja quem a Third Bridge Group contratou para este cargo Candidatar-se Salvar Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to fueling decisions with expert insights. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies. What You'll Do You will provide vital legal support for our US operations, focusing on the efficient execution of commercial agreements and contributing to our legal innovation roadmap. Working closely with our Head of Legal in the UK and our wider international legal team, you will help navigate the legal landscape of a high-growth environment. This role can be done remotely within the US, although travel to one of our offices: New York, Dallas or LA is preferred. Your Responsibilities Include Commercial Contracting: Support the drafting, negotiation, and review of agreements (client contracts, vendor contracts, NDAs). You will work alongside senior team members to provide rapid, high-quality turnaround for our commercial teams. Regulatory Compliance Support: Help advise the business on US financial services regulations, securities law, and data privacy. You will assist in ensuring consistency and compliance across our operations under the guidance of the global legal team. Legal Advisory & Training: Assist in translating complex legal requirements into plain language for internal stakeholders. You will support the delivery of training to commercial and HR teams, helping balance risk with business opportunity. Legal Innovation & Process Improvement: Assist in the evolution of our legal tech stack. You will play a key role in the day-to-day implementation of AI solutions and CLM tools to help streamline processes and enable business self-service. What You’ll Bring Legal Qualification: From an accredited US law school and an active bar admission in Texas or another US state (or ability to obtain Texas bar admission). Commercial Foundation: Developing experience in contract drafting and negotiation. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and eager to grow your commercial skills. Regulatory Interest: A strong interest or foundational experience in financial services, securities law, and compliance frameworks. Familiarity with IP and data protection laws is a plus. Innovation Mindset: A genuine enthusiasm for legal tech and automation. You are excited about using AI to reduce manual workloads. Communication Skills: The ability to explain legal concepts clearly and a desire to learn how legal strategy enables sales and business velocity. Organization: Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Collaboration: A proactive team player who enjoys learning from others and building relationships across commercial, compliance, and technology teams. Preferred Experience: Experience within a SaaS company, tech-first environment, or information services is highly regarded. Compensation & Benefits Location: REMOTE US, although NYC, DAL and LA are preferred Salary: $145,000 base salary plus annual company bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance. Vacation: 15 vacation days and 2 personal days, increasing to 20 vacation days after 2 years of service. Volunteer Time: 2 CSR volunteer days annually. Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare coverage through Cigna (including a 100% employer-paid option), Wellhub access, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Insurance: Life insurance and long-term disability coverage. Savings Accounts: Pre-tax commuter, dependent care FSA, HSA, and medical FSA options. Retirement: 401(k) plan with Roth and traditional options, including a company match of up to 5%. Access to Prosperwise financial advice. Additional Perks: Competitive parental leave, pet insurance, personal development allowance, and phone allowance. Culture: Stocked kitchens, regular social gatherings, and a strong commitment to ESG and Diversity & Inclusion initiatives. Third Bridge values your trust and is committed to the responsible management, use, and protection of personal information. By submitting a Third Bridge job application, I hereby provide Third Bridge (including Third Bridge's affiliates and relevant third-party suppliers) with my consent to collect, store and process my personal information for the purpose of recruitment administration, as well as to share such personal information with third parties for the same purpose, in accordance with the Candidate Privacy Notice. We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you are not 100% sure if you are right for the role, please apply anyway, and we will be happy to consider your application. paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Legal Counsel - DAL position within Third Bridge Group's team. The opportunity to work across international contract law, IP, and privacy law at a globally recognised company is exactly the kind of environment I have been working towards – and I am confident my background makes me a strong fit.

I hold an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and have practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in a corporate legal practice. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5–7 commercial agreements per month – NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts – while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. More recently, I completed a professional language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu, where I worked directly within a Finnish law firm environment, developing my Finnish legal vocabulary and observing local legal processes first-hand.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

Third Bridge Group's in-house model – working directly alongside the General Counsel and gaining exposure to corporate-level legal operations – is precisely the learning environment I am seeking. I am available for the September 2026 start and can commit to the part-time schedule during the academic year, transitioning to full-time over summer.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
